title: ArcCivs176: owned road shoulder continuity and reserved construction admission
owner_requirement: Fix Village-1/2 development and find fifth village, using explicitly authorized captured terrain/plans and blacklist input policy.
proposed_change: Preserve actual owned DIRT_PATH shoulders when ordinary routes join them at their unchanged native floor; keep building pads excluded. Try existing unpaid same-type reserved plots before full recovery. Admit an already queued construction site before new speculative planning in the shared two-job world budget.
physical_item_effect: All work keeps existing blueprint bills, paid native receipts, queues, work periods and ordinary supplies. Fewer false geometry refusals and admission starvation may restore actual item consumption and later production; throughput is unmeasured.
founding_item_effect: No new founding or reserve change in176. Village-5 was founded once on175 with existing216-item reserve. ExistingID repeat0; no manual grants.
assumptions: No new currency/XP reward, drop chance, shop rate or paid-work speed.
Participants1/4/5and0/1/2planningevents perday are sensitivity inputs, not measured player activity or new caps.
Existing Auto deficit restock and ordinary production remain real possible downstream item sources; no self-sufficiency or zero indirect effect claim.
Active EconomyShopGUI SELL and futureSHADOWcontracts are distinct and unchanged.
live_verification: Observe ordinary paid V1/V2 construction and Village-5 queued builder activation after restart. No forced arrivals, world edits or manual resources to pass.

route_shoulder_repair.before: 21 reconstructed compatible V2 routes all fail actual Terraform draft on one DIRT_PATH shoulder of the validated paid hall road; planned and native floors match.
route_shoulder_repair.after: Retain only captured loaded dirt-path shoulders at actual native surface, within one column and one floor of a validated route. Ordinary route preparation requires exact requested/native floor equality and excludes the building pad. Native support/body/authority and preimage checks still run.

queue_admission.before: The development pulse runs before construction queue admission; both use the same five-second cadence and shared two-job placement budget. Native Village-5 builder hut has remained queued with world-busy.
queue_admission.after: Run ordinary queued construction admission first. While its activation future is in flight or an eligible loaded head last waited on the shared world budget, defer new access repair/development planning until admission retries. Success or a non-capacity refusal releases the hold; paused/unloaded/unhealthy queues do not hold it. Same existing two jobs and five-second retry, no additional work speed or supplies.
